thought.text: The dev server's pid file is blocking it. After clearing it, I'll start the production server:

reasoning_content: The server's pidfile is left over from the development server. I'll delete it and then start it up again.

action.command: cd /workspace && rm -f tmp/pids/server.pid && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root RAILS_ENV=production && nohup bin/rails s -b 0.0.0.0 -p 3001 > /tmp/rails_server_prod.log 2>&1 & echo started; sleep 35; tail -8 /tmp/rails_server_prod.log
